prompt: This code compiles but leaks the file handle. Why?
choices: FileReader cannot be wrapped in BufferedReader
readLine() throws IOException which must be caught
The reader is never closed — the file handle leaks if an exception occurs
BufferedReader requires an explicit buffer size
explanation: If readLine() throws, the reader is never closed. Fix: use try-with-resources: 'try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(...))) { ... }'
